title: The Persian empire falls to Alexander
summary: Jones dates the fall of the Persian empire to Alexander.
description: Jones dates the fall of the Persian empire to Alexander. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed. He does not name the battle of Gaugamela. That battle keeps its own sort.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 331 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: Not applied to battle-of-gaugamela. Jones's line does not name the battle. The match was doubtful, so the battle was left on its previous sort.
